validated_results.title: Risk of cancer in regular and low meat-eaters, fish-eaters, and vegetarians: a prospective analysis of UK Biobank participants.
validated_results.reason: Prospective UK Biobank cohort reporting incident prostate cancer risk for vegetarians versus regular meat-eaters, a dietary-pattern exposure with a target-specific estimate.

extraction.population: UK Biobank participants who were free from cancer at recruitment

cases.excerpt: After an average follow-up of 11.4 years, 54,961 incident cancers were identified, including 5882 colorectal, 7537 postmenopausal breast, and 9501 prostate cancers.
